definitions: Perform duties or services for (a person or organization).
Be of use in achieving or satisfying something.
Spend a period of time in prison or in the armed forces.
Deliver (a legal document) to the person concerned.
Hit (the ball or shuttlecock) to start play in a game such as tennis or volleyball.
examples: He served his country for many years.
The new policy will serve to improve efficiency.
She served two years for theft.
The summons was served on him yesterday.
